title: Assignment plan
findingDetail: Checking which assignments fit the rules.
staleResult: This result is from the last run. Run the edited setup to refresh it.
noPlanDetail: Run the example to see who should take each job.
noScheduleChange: Running a plan does not change anyone’s schedule
staleMessage: This message is from the last run.
invalidDetail: The service couldn’t use this setup. Check the JSON or try the example again.
invalidExampleDetail: The service couldn’t use this setup. Review who can take each job, or reset to the example.
limitDetail: This run was too large to check. Reduce the options per job or try a smaller group of jobs. This does not mean the jobs can’t be assigned.
ambiguousDetail: The service could not accept this setup or it exceeded the search limit. Check the definition and try a smaller problem.
busyDetail: Give it a moment, then run the plan again.
offlineDetail: Check your connection or try again shortly.
executionDetail: The service encountered an error. No conclusion was reached about these jobs.
responseDetail: The service didn’t return an assignment plan in the expected format.
infeasibleTitle: No assignment fits all the rules
infeasibleDetail: Try making another person available or changing which jobs overlap.
largeNumbers: Some numbers are too large to display safely in the summary. The exact result is below.
requestFormatTitle: The service couldn’t read the request
requestFormatDetail: Check the JSON format against the example, or reset to the sample and try again.
problemTitle: The service couldn’t use this planning model
problemDetail: Review the jobs, eligible resources, and rules. The service rejected the setup before finding an assignment.
endpointDetail: Check that this app is connected to an Orchestrata service that supports planning.
rejectedDetail: Check the setup or ask your administrator for help. No assignment was calculated.
accessDetail: Your session or permissions do not allow this request. Sign in again or ask your administrator. The previous plan is still available.
